race.comment: BANNERED (2) sets the standard after resuming with a controlled Belmont Park win in NMW1Y grade, where he was sent out favourite and beat Dreamers Never Die by just over half a length. He comes here second-up with a solid 1200m record and that latest form gives him the clearest winning platform. THINK PINK DAZE (7) resumes from a five-month break after finishing fourth in the Listed Belmont Oaks and has since won a Lark Hill trial, so her class and readiness both appeal. NATURE'S RECKONING (6) has been around the mark in two Northam runs this campaign, was beaten just over a length last time and now gets weight relief with first-time blinkers. HISTORY WON'T CARE (3) was sound late from Saturday company at Ascot and the Pike booking keeps him in the minor-winning mix if he sharpens second-up. RODNEY OH RODNEY (8) is next best.
